observations.body: The God of the ancestors repeatedly sends messengers, gives the people over after sustained rejection, and later stirs Cyrus to rebuild.
observations.label: God warns, judges, and stirs return: action

observations.body: Leaders mock messengers, the city falls, survivors go into exile, and a Persian king issues a return decree.
observations.label: God warns, judges, and stirs return: response

observations.body: sent again and again · no remedy · fulfilled · stirred up

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 36:15–23 as judgment, exile, and the nations evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: “No remedy” closes one sequence but does not mean God’s relation to the people ends.
